summary: Worker-2 recovered image-only Table 1 MIC evidence, worker-4 reconciled linked APD6/DBAASP rows to local primary table and supplement sequence locators, and worker-6 closed the prior source-review rework with explicit nonblocking cautions.
adjudication_summary: The previous failure was controlled: activity rows are now source-locator-backed, database rows are reconciled or preserved as source-verified summaries, and no open blocking rework remains after local source exhaustion.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP row-level MIC entries match Table 1 cells; APD6 activity text is verified as range-style summary evidence against Table 1 and Supplementary Table EV1. No database-only activity claim is promoted without a local source locator.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Table 1 image supplied 71 non-ND MIC cells for Api1b plus newly tested PrAMPs. ND cells and absent toxicity endpoints are retained without fabrication.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are limited to source-supported Type II ribosome-targeting evidence from abstract, toeprinting/readthrough figures, crystallography figure/table, and data availability locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker6_final_decision: accepted_with_cautions because the recovered local evidence clears the blocking worker-2/4/6 issues while image-table and APD6 summary caveats remain visible.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary MIC values are embedded in OA package Table 1 image rather than structured XML; worker-2 manually reviewed the image and cross-checked 67 DBAASP assay rows.
Five APD6 entries summarize activity ranges; row-level MIC values are represented from Table 1/DBAASP, while APD6 range comments are source-verified as summaries.
Local XML/PDF/supplement/database rows checked here do not report hemolysis/cytotoxicity values for these peptides.
